# Datavault AI to Acquire CyberCatch for $94.5 Million in Cash

Datavault AI Inc. (Nasdaq: DVLT) has agreed to acquire CyberCatch Holdings, Inc. (TSXV: CYBE; OTCQB: CYBHF) for approximately $94.5 million in cash, adding an AI-enabled cybersecurity and continuous compliance platform to its data infrastructure and computing technology portfolio.

Under the definitive agreement, Datavault AI will acquire all approximately 26.8 million issued and outstanding CyberCatch common shares for $3.53 per share. Outstanding dilutive securities will be exchanged on a cashless-exercise basis. The transaction is structured as a court-approved plan of arrangement under British Columbia law. [...] The acquisition is intended to integrate CyberCatch’s cybersecurity software into Datavault AI’s Quantum Private Network GPU ecosystem, giving the company a continuous compliance and cyber risk management layer across its broader data and AI infrastructure. Datavault AI is positioning the combination to address an information security market that Gartner projected would reach $213 billion in worldwide end-user spending in 2025. [...] The acquisition also adds CyberCatch’s MARS-MABE encryption technology, which the company is working to make quantum resistant. The technology is designed to provide fine-grained access to specific subsets of data based on user attributes while allowing access rights to be revoked without re-encrypting an entire data set. Datavault AI sees potential applications across defense, healthcare, financial services, manufacturing and energy.

“Cybersecurity is no longer a separate stack from data and AI,” Datavault AI CEO Nathaniel T. Bradley said. “It is the precondition for both.” Bradley said CyberCatch is expected to add real-time risk and compliance signals across Datavault AI’s edge infrastructure.
